subject.title: Native Anthropic path: replaying historical `thinking` blocks bricks long tool-use threads (`Invalid signature in thinking block` 400)

question: Which open Anthropic thinking-signature replay PR should be the canonical fix path for this issue and the linked no-compaction/compaction/recovery cluster?
rationale: The issue is valid, but several overlapping open PRs change different replay and recovery layers; choosing the durable boundary is a maintainer product and compatibility decision rather than a safe new autonomous repair job.

options.title: Use the scoped native replay PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 as the canonical no-compaction completed-turn fix, then retarget broader sanitizer or context-pruning PRs around any remaining gaps.

options.title: Adopt the broader sanitizer PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100149 if maintainers want the generic session-history sanitizer to own non-latest signed-thinking cleanup across more surfaces.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker while separate PRs land for no-compaction replay, boundaryless compaction, and terminal recovery carriers.

recommendation.title: Use the scoped native replay PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 as the canonical no-compaction completed-turn fix, then retarget broader sanitizer or context-pruning PRs around any remaining gaps.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently merged related Anthropic replay/recovery work and are the strongest available routing signal for deciding among overlapping active PRs.
